description: Source code for Express.js route handlers managing CRUD operations for 'events', including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, deleting events, and managing attendees, with Swagger annotations for API documentation.

methods.name: GET /events
methods.description: Handles listing of events with optional pagination.

methods.name: GET /events/:id
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific event by ID.

methods.name: POST /events
methods.description: Creates a new event; requires authentication.

methods.name: PUT /events/:id
methods.description: Updates an existing event; requires authentication and ownership.

methods.name: DELETE /events/:id
methods.description: Deletes an event; requires authentication and ownership.

methods.name: GET /events/:id/attendees
methods.description: Lists attendees for a specific event.

methods.name: POST /events/:id/attendees
methods.description: Adds an attendee to an event; owner only.

methods.name: DELETE /events/:id/attendees/:userId
methods.description: Removes an attendee from an event; owner only.
